export_mephisto_db_dump: export Mephisto database records to a timestamped archive file with optional task filtering
import_mephisto_db_dump: import Mephisto database records from a zip archive file with conflict resolution
create_mephisto_db_backup: create a full backup of the local Mephisto data directory and databases
restore_mephisto_db_backup: restore the local Mephisto data directory from a previously created backup file
prepare_partial_dump_data: prepare a partial database dump filtered by task names, IDs, or run labels
